name: remnic
description: Universal memory for AI agents — automatic recall, observation, and cross-agent knowledge sharing

remnic_daemon_token.title: Remnic Daemon Bearer Token
remnic_daemon_token.description: Bearer token the MCP server sends on every request. Mint via `remnic token generate claude-code` (or `remnic connectors install claude-code` on first install).

remnic_daemon_url.title: Remnic Daemon MCP URL
remnic_daemon_url.description: Full URL of the Remnic daemon's MCP endpoint. Default http://localhost:4318/mcp. Use http:// loopback or https:// — plaintext http to non-loopback is rejected because the bearer token travels with every request.
